volunteer.title: Volunteer enquiry received
volunteer.message: Thank you for offering your time. Volunteering costs you nothing.
details: Availability: placements open throughout the year, depending on current projects.
A volunteer coordinator will contact you within 3 working days.
Please have your ID and emergency contact details ready.
